text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2015.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2015

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi lima ratus lapan puluh tiga juta dan

empat ratus tiga puluh empat ribu ringgit (RM583,434,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan

daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2015 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 220,648,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 192,971,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain RM 41,227,000

Perbelanjaan lain RM 58,584,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 70,004,000

____________________

Jumlah RM 583,434,000

 ____________________

Dibuat 10 Mac 2015

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XIX]

DATO' SRI RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2015.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2015

2. A sum not exceeding five hundred and eighty three million and four hundred and

thirty four thousand ringgit (RM583,434,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security

Fund for expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the

year 2015 as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 220,648,000

Supplies and services RM 192,971,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 41,227,000

Other expenditures RM 58,584,000

Landed property, plant and equipment RM 70,004,000

_____________________

Total RM 583,434,000

_____________________

Made 10 March 2015

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XIX]

 DATO' SRI RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

 Minister of Human Resources
